name: Speaking With The Dead
overview: Scripture clearly forbids seeking communication with the dead or engaging with familiar spirits and wizards, warning that such practices defile the believer and provoke God's judgment, including severe consequences as outlined in Leviticus and Deuteronomy. The Bible emphasizes that the dead do not praise the LORD nor possess knowledge or reward, underscoring the futility and spiritual danger of attempting contact with them. These passages affirm that true life and hope are found only in the living God, not through occult practices.
